bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest story is Chicago's quarterback situation ahead of tonight's Week 3 Monday Night Football matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles, with Caleb Williams already ruled out due to his hamstring injury , and veteran Case Keenum reportedly getting the start against the Eagles on Monday night . Adding to the backup quarterback intrigue, the Bears' updated injury report shows Tyson Bagent is good to go as insurance behind Keenum for tonight's primetime showdown at Soldier Field.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions defeated the New York Jets 31-24 in Week 3, with Jahmyr Gibbs leading the way with a huge performance, including a big day for Gibbs, total team effort, a key defensive call, and getting everybody involved . Gibbs also had a memorable moment, as he honored Aaron Glenn with his touchdown celebration against the New York Jets , while looking ahead the Lions now turn their attention to a Week 4 road matchup against the Panthers.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers signed veteran offensive lineman Laken Tomlinson off the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad in an effort to bolster their struggling offensive line. The Packers made a move on Saturday to bolster their woeful o-line, signing veteran Laken Tomlinson off the Dallas Cowboys' practice squad.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest Vikings story from the past 24 hours centers on a concerning injury update, as tight end Josh Oliver suffered a potentially significant injury during the team's game against the Buccaneers . The setback raises questions about depth at tight end as Minnesota looks to build on its strong start to the 2026 season.
